title: Diffusion Editing with Soft Mask: Pixel Level Redo of Image and Video with Adjustable Strength
abstract: arXiv:2610.00359v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion models with prompt and reference image-guided editing have seen rapid progress, yet they remain too coarse for pixel-level control. One promising direction is to incorporate a soft mask that specifies spatially varying edit strengths but training such fine-grained control demands expensive pixel-wise annotations, while existing zero-shot methods often yield unsatisfactory results. We introduce SoftPaint, a new zero-shot sampling method that leverages soft masks to enable a continuous spectrum of edits, from fully preserving the original content to completely re-synthesizing the masked region. Going beyond zero-shot inpainting methods, we design a Langevin-iteration-based sampler that respects per-pixel soft mask strengths, which applies universally to image and video diffusion models, enabling tasks such as video editing. translated_title: 基于软掩码的扩散编辑：具有可调节强度的图像与视频像素级重绘
translated_abstract: 基于提示词与参考图像引导的扩散模型编辑技术进展迅速，但仍难以实现像素级的精细控制。一个有前景的方向是引入软掩码来指定空间上变化的编辑强度，然而训练这种细粒度控制需要昂贵的逐像素标注，而现有的零样本方法往往效果不尽人意。我们提出 SoftPaint，一种新的零样本采样方法，利用软掩码实现连续可调的编辑谱系，从完全保留原始内容到完全重新合成被掩码区域。超越零样本图像修复方法，我们设计了一种基于 Langevin 迭代的采样器，能够遵循逐像素的软掩码强度，并可普遍应用于图像和视频扩散模型，从而支持视频编辑等任务。该方法无需梯度、内存高效，可在多张图像和视频上实现平滑的像素级编辑。
tldr: 提出零样本采样方法 SoftPaint，通过软掩码与基于 Langevin 迭代的采样器实现逐像素、强度可调的图像与视频扩散编辑，无需昂贵的逐像素标注即可在完全保留与完全重绘之间平滑过渡。
